notes.grounding: Options, argument loop, Overall Completion line, OVERALL_PERCENTAGE/stats-file percentage, printf %.0f rounding, bc guard, trailing exit-code comment (0 and 1) and the measured runs all match the real script; re-running both commands reproduced 100%/exit 0 and 'ERROR: Unexpected argument: 80'/exit 1. One risk misstates Bash behavior, and the transcript silently drops the separator lines.
notes.requirements: Exit 3 below N, exit 0 at or above N and when absent, stdout unchanged in text and JSON, missing/non-integer/out-of-range N rejected with exit 1 and no report, --file mode covered; all testable with concrete fixtures.

notes.scope: Stays on the one option at Level 1, out-of-scope items justified, no filler and no unfilled tokens.
notes.consistency: Ids, exit codes, file path and 80/90/70 numbers agree across files; T017 validates a folder path that appears nowhere else, and SC-002's pre-change comparison has no matching task.
notes.clarity: Global, case branch, error strings, placement of the comparison after output and before exit 0, and the per-mode percentage source are all stated; a developer could implement without questions.
